definitions.explanation: The network of vessels visible on a leaf that carries water and nutrients between the stem and the leaf tissue.

examples.japanese: {葉|は}に{細|こま}かい{葉脈|ようみゃく}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: Fine leaf veins are visible on the leaf.

examples.japanese: {葉脈|ようみゃく}の{模様|もよう}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The pattern of the leaf veins is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {顕微鏡|けんびきょう}で{植物|しょくぶつ}の{葉脈|ようみゃく}の{構造|こうぞう}を{観察|かんさつ}した。
examples.english: I observed the structure of plant leaf veins under a microscope.

notes:
Composed of {葉|は} (leaf) + {脈|みゃく} (vein).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細|こま}かい{葉脈|ようみゃく}: fine veins
- {葉脈|ようみゃく}が{走|はし}る: veins run (across a leaf)
- {葉脈|ようみゃく}の{模様|もよう}: pattern of leaf veins

USAGE:
Unlike {鉱脈|こうみゃく} (ore vein) or {血管|けっかん} (blood vessel), {葉脈|ようみゃく} refers strictly to the vascular pattern of plant leaves and is largely a botanical term.
